parsed.summary: The PR adds an async response function to ASGIStaticFilesHandler, which should resolve the issue. However, there are concerns about maintainability and potential regressions.

issues.description: The added async function is not clearly separated from the synchronous one, which may reduce maintainability.
There is a risk that the new async function may introduce unexpected behavior or regressions in existing use cases.
The PR does not include any new tests to verify the functionality of the added async response function.
